paras: I got poor answers from AI too, until I learned to treat it like a person who can't read my mind. I still slip when I'm lazy, and I pay for it by doing the work again.

The bundle on the next page is the book that teaches that skill, with a Toolkit of prompts and roles, a Workbook that has you run one real task from your week, and two more guides. It is $27, with a 30-day money-back promise.
